Before filing this, check whether it is instead a vulnerability that needs private handling, if so, use GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" tab on this repository instead of a public issue. See SECURITY.md for details.

## Entry name

As it appears in data/skills.json or data/connectors.json.

## What's wrong with it

- [ ] Link is dead or redirects somewhere unrelated
- [ ] Project looks abandoned (no commits, no response to issues)
- [ ] Asks for more access or permissions than the description implies
- [ ] Something else, describe below

## Evidence

A link to the archived repo notice, the issue thread, or whatever shows the problem.

## What you'd suggest

- [ ] Remove the entry
- [ ] Mark it deprecated with a note
- [ ] Fix the link or description (if you know the correct one)
